q1_issues.issue: The concessive force is lost: no atom relates the searching to the denied finding, and (Even sk_town_1 sk_search_1) instead reads "even the town searched", while in the sentence the particle scopes over the whole with-clause set against the main clause.
"the WHOLE town" is reduced to a bare (Member sk_town_1 town) — the totality quantification is dropped entirely.

(Ongoing sk_search_1) matches none of the four explicit Ongoing markers the instruction set allows (progressive auxiliary, continuative perfect, inceptive complement, perception-verb participle) — the -ing here is an absolute participle.

q2_gaps: "even with NP V-ing" — a preposition + absolute participial adjunct expressing concession; the connective section covers subordinating conjunctions (although / even though / despite) and the focus section covers a particle sitting on a constituent, but neither covers this augmented-absolute construction or says whether the adjunct's event carries tense of its own
"the whole N" as a totality modifier on a singular collective noun — the quantifier lexicon runs all/every/most/a lot of/many/few/no, and "whole" maps to none of them
notes: The "no one" negative universal as a strength-0.0 distribution rule over (Member $x person) with its companion, Theme for the found person, and the projected Name/property atoms for little Fadil outside the denial all follow the instruction set.
